title: Find the possible x-values
text: As $$t$$ ranges over all positive numbers, $$x=\ln\left(2t\right)$$ takes every real value.

title: Check the ends
text: As $$x$$ goes to $$-\infty$$, $$\frac{e^{2x}}{4}$$ approaches $$0$$, so $$y=0$$ is a horizontal asymptote. As $$x$$ goes to $$\infty$$, $$y$$ grows without bound, and there is no vertical asymptote.
